integrity: All analytic identities are derived from labeled cell transitions; finite code is supporting only.
scientific_limitations: Annealed first return from uniform initial coordinate in a prescribed central side only. Side-change and return time depend within excursions. Derivation uses known cell graph and classical one-level first-passage methods; equivalently published bivariate kernels remain a priority risk.
title: An exact oriented renewal kernel for the critical random interval map
